title: Vietnam Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Vietnam
paragraphs: There are plenty of western style restaurants throughout Vietnam, particularly in the more touristy areas. These restaurants are often dramatically more expensive than their local counterparts, and they are often a poor reflection on western cuisine. Stick to the local restaurants that serve up Vietnamese food and you'll save yourself a lot of money and have more interesting and delicious meals.
Whilerestaurant and meal prices in Vietnamcan vary significantly, theaverage cost of food in Vietnamis $21 (d557,098) per day, per person, based on the spending habits of previous travelers.

When dining out, the average daily cost for food in Vietnam is about $21 (d557098) per person. Previous travelers have typically spent from $9 to $52 per day. Generally, breakfast and lunch will cost less than dinner, but that will vary based on the type of restaurant and what you order.
